PR_Title: Fix WebSocket live updates not pushing to overlay
Commit_Message:
Fix WebSocket live updates not pushing to overlay

The log watcher uses watchdog which runs in a separate thread, while
the WebSocket server runs in uvicorn's asyncio event loop. The previous
code tried to use asyncio.get_running_loop() from the watchdog thread,
which failed silently due to the except RuntimeError: pass block.

Fix: Capture the event loop on FastAPI startup and use
asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe() for cross-thread async scheduling.
